note: One record per failure class. A class may occur once; a second instance of an open class is a governance failure, not a new incident.

instances: pennyd reserved budget money it never wrote down: a reservation that could not be written still let the dispatch go out (F-BU-6)
pennyd lost the reservation on restart, releasing money that was still at risk (F-BU-7)
pennyd let a stale writer clobber a newer ledger's financial records (F-BU-8)
pennyd read a corrupt ledger as an empty ledger, and an empty ledger is a full budget (F-BU-10)
pennyd charged a retried operation twice, because the reservation carried no operation id (F-BU-11)
pennyd's midnight rollover released funds that were still reserved (F-BU-9, F-BU-12)
classes.gap: the budget ledger kept only per-key spend and had no record of the money encumbered for an in-flight operation, so nothing in the ledger could say whether money was already spoken for
classes.compensating_action: reserve and settle are keyed by the operation id (the client's x-idempotency-key) and the ledger persists the reservations; a reservation that cannot be written is refused and rolled back (503 ledger_unavailable); a ledger that cannot be parsed poisons the store instead of granting a fresh budget; the ledger carries a write counter and a stale writer refuses rather than clobbering newer records; an unsettled reservation survives a restart and the day boundary until it is reconciled (platform/llm/pennyd, idp#8236, landed as idp#8237)

instances: 3acbf81b3 (PR #7117) added the #7116 comment that the DB stand-in must be Ready BEFORE flux_source lays the GitSource and in the same hunk deleted the stand_in_database() call, so the comment describes an ordering nothing implements; every shadow run since leaves litellm CrashLoopBackOff on P1001 (run 44363967714)
classes.gap: a hunk can add a comment asserting an invariant and delete the only code that enforces it, and nothing fails: no test asserts the call exists, so the prose reads as proof of a behaviour the harness does not have
classes.compensating_action: call stand_in_database() before flux_source(head) whenever db_needs_standin(paths), and add the ordering falsifier that fails when the call is absent or moved after the source
classes.falsifier: tests/test_the_shadow_lays_the_database_before_the_source.py refuses a bin/idp-shadow whose _verify lays the GitSource before the DB stand-in
